title: %addMonths - shift a date by whole months
purpose: Add (or subtract) a number of months to a date, returning an ISO date.
notes: Month arithmetic uses calendar-month stepping, not a fixed day count.
A negative count moves the date backward.
A day absent from the target month is clamped to that month's last day (Jan 31 + 1 month is Feb 29 in a leap year, Feb 28 otherwise), not rolled forward.
